license: Original AI-generated artwork for CoachFit; bundled for offline use

ownership.source: OpenAI built-in ImageGen (or equivalent) — match assets/images/editorial/manifest.json's house style
ownership.usage: Product editorial surfaces only; do not imply a real person endorsement.

styleNotes: Natural, contemporary, editorial photography-style renders. Diverse adult athletes, safe/correct form, home-or-gym settings that match the app's existing warm-neutral palette. Generous negative space on one side for UI copy/scrim. No visible text, logos, or brand marks in the image itself.

wiring.subtypeCards: Once approved, set GoalPreset.cardImage in src/app-lib/goal-presets.ts to require('../../assets/images/goals/subtypes/<file>') for the matching preset id. SubtypeChoiceCard (src/design/components/goal-hero.tsx) already renders it when present and gracefully falls back to a plain ChoiceTile when cardImage is undefined, so presets can be filled in incrementally.
wiring.categoryHeroes: Once approved, replace the duplicated entries in WORKOUT_HEADER_BACKGROUNDS (src/features/exercise-detail.tsx) — barre and pilates currently both point at assets/images/heroes/yoga-hero.png, sculpting at bodybuilding-hero.png — with the new dedicated file.
wiring.generalFitnessCard: PRIMARY_GOAL_OPTIONS_BY_ID.general_fitness.cardImage in src/app-lib/goal-presets.ts currently reuses assets/images/editorial/explore-general-v1.png as an interim fix (previously duplicated lose_weight's fat-burn-card.png). Swap in the dedicated card once generated; this one is lower priority since the interim fix already reads as distinct.
